title: SPPU In-Sem Examination Schedule - Term I (2026-27)
author: Controller of Examinations
shortDescription: Official timetable for Savitribai Phule Pune University (SPPU) in-semester theory examinations for SE, TE, and BE branches.
fullText: All students of Second Year, Third Year, and Final Year B.Tech are hereby notified that the SPPU In-Semester Theory Examinations for Term-I of Academic Year 2026-27 will commence from 1st December 2026. The detailed subject-wise schedules and classroom seat allocations have been published on the departmental notice boards and the student ERP portal. Students must carry their valid college ID cards and college examination hall tickets. Any form of malpractice will be strictly dealt with as per university ordinances.

title: Registration Open: TECHNOVISION 2026 - National Tech Symposium
author: Student Council & ISTE Chapter
shortDescription: Annual national-level flagship technical symposium featuring 24-hr Hackathons, Robo-Wars, Paper Presentations, and Coding Battles.
fullText: D. Y. Patil College of Engineering, Akurdi Pune, proudly presents its annual national technical fiesta 'TECHNOVISION 2026' scheduled for 18th-20th January 2027. Events include: 1. 24-Hour AI & Web3 Hackathon (Cash Prize: ₹1,50,000), 2. Robo-Wars & Drone Racing Championship, 3. IEEE National Technical Paper Presentation, 4. Code Marathon & Blind Coding. Interested teams across all engineering disciplines must register online before 20th December 2026. Certificates and trophies for all participants.

title: First Year B.Tech & Direct Second Year (DSE) Admission Guidance Cell
author: Central Admission Committee
shortDescription: Facilitation centre (FC) and document verification assistance open for State CET Cell CAP Rounds for prospective engineering aspirants.
fullText: The College Central Admission Guidance Cell is actively operating at the Akurdi Campus for all candidates seeking admission to First Year B.Tech and Direct Second Year (DSE) under the State CET Cell CAP Rounds 2026-27. Free expert guidance on branch preference filing, scholarship documentation (EBC, TFWS, SC/ST/OBC), and document e-scrutiny verification is available daily from 9:30 AM to 5:00 PM at the Main Seminar Hall. Contact: 020-27653058.

title: Mandatory Submission of Anti-Ragging Affidavit (AY 2026-27)
author: Office of the Principal
shortDescription: Statutory compliance circular regarding online anti-ragging undertaking by all registered students and parents as mandated by AICTE/UGC.
fullText: As per the strict guidelines and directions of the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India, UGC, and AICTE, it is mandatory for all undergraduate and postgraduate engineering students and their parents to submit the online Anti-Ragging Undertaking at www.antiragging.in. After submission, a printed copy of the confirmation undertaking signed by the student and parent must be handed over to their respective class teacher on or before 25th November 2026.

title: Campus Placement Drive: Tier-1 Tech Giants & Product Companies
author: Training & Placement Cell (T&P)
shortDescription: Upcoming recruitment visits by leading product and consulting conglomerates for Final Year students of Computer, IT, AI&DS, and E&TC.
fullText: The Training & Placement Cell is pleased to announce the upcoming campus recruitment schedule for the 2027 graduating batch. Companies scheduled to visit in December 2026 include Tata Consultancy Services (Digital & Prime), Cognizant GenC Next, Veritas Technologies, Barclays, and ZS Associates. Eligible students who have maintained a minimum aggregate of 60% without live backlogs must register on the Superset T&P portal before 22nd November 2026.

title: Academic Calendar Revision: Commencement of Term-II Classes
author: Dean Academic Affairs
shortDescription: Updated academic schedule and timeline for laboratory submissions, industrial tours, and commencement of Term-II lectures.
fullText: The Academic Council has approved the revised academic calendar for the ongoing session. Students are notified that the last date for Term-I continuous internal evaluation and laboratory journal submissions is 28th November 2026. Following the university semester examinations, classes for Term-II will formally begin on 15th January 2027. Attendance criteria of minimum 75% will be strictly enforced as per university norms.

title: Call for Papers: IEEE International Conference on Smart Computing (ICSC 2027)
author: Department of Computer Engg. & IEEE
shortDescription: Invitation to submit original research papers in fields of edge AI, cybersecurity, renewable systems, and distributed computing.
fullText: The Department of Computer Engineering and Electronics & Telecommunication at DYPCOE, in technical co-sponsorship with IEEE Pune Section, announces the 4th IEEE International Conference on Smart Computing and Sustainable Systems (ICSC 2027). Faculty members, research scholars, and postgraduate students are invited to submit their original, unpublished research papers via Microsoft CMT. Accepted and presented papers will be submitted for inclusion into IEEE Xplore digital library.

title: Hostel Fee Remittance & Mess Committee Elections Circular
author: Chief Rector, Campus Hostels
shortDescription: Guidelines regarding hostel installment payments for Term-II and nominations for the student Mess Advisory Council.
fullText: All resident students residing in Boys' Hostels (Sahyadri & Shivneri) and Girls' Hostels (Indrayani & Saraswati) are informed that the second installment of hostel and mess maintenance fees must be remitted via the college ERP fee portal on or before 10th December 2026. In addition, nominations for the student representative committee for hostel food quality monitoring and sports facilities are now open at the Rector Office.
